name: rabbey-darling-red-stella
about: v194: Rabbey Darling (26RDB01-002) LV1-2 (When Summoned): 'If all your Spirits/Nexuses have Red Stella, send a core, besides Soul Core, from your Trash to this Spirit. Then, target one of your exhausted Red Stella Spirits. Send a core, besides Soul Core, from your Trash to it.' = if allHave team Red Stella + TRASH_CORES_TO toSelf then TRASH_CORES_TO {match {team Red Stella, exhausted}} (the instance filter). LV2 (Your End Step): 'You can target one of your Red Stella Spirits. Refresh it.' = END_STEP + REFRESH_SPIRIT {match team}.
